verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are by design fresh, isolated, ephemeral environments for running untrusted or agent code. Network controls (block_network and CIDR/domain allowlists), mountable Volumes and snapshots let a user test in a contained environment without reaching production systems. The evidence is first-party only, and none of it frames the feature as separating test data from production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, explicit docs on keeping production data or credentials out of sandboxes (e.g., seeding test data or scoping secrets).
